font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans Mono', 'Bitstream Vera Sans Mono', 'Computer Modern Typewriter', 'Andale Mono', 'Nimbus Mono L', 'Courier New', 'Courier', 'Fixed', 'Terminal', monospace

g.text: DOT = winding START. SPICE puts the DOT on an L element's first node, and positive K couples DOT to DOT.

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans Mono', 'Bitstream Vera Sans Mono', 'Computer Modern Typewriter', 'Andale Mono', 'Nimbus Mono L', 'Courier New', 'Courier', 'Fixed', 'Terminal', monospace

g.text: Deck: Lsa_i out a_i -> CTAP is S_A's DOT; Lsb_i b_i out -> SEC_B is S_B's DOT, CTAP is S_B's NON-dot.

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans Mono', 'Bitstream Vera Sans Mono', 'Computer Modern Typewriter', 'Andale Mono', 'Nimbus Mono L', 'Courier New', 'Courier', 'Fixed', 'Terminal', monospace

g.text: Do NOT join the two DOTs at the centre tap: that makes both halves the same phase and the rectifier stops working.

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle
